body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> ZOTAC, world's best graphic card and mainboard manufacturer, announced the first ITX mainboard ZOTAC 'H67 ITX WIFI' supporting H67 socket of Intel Sandy Bridge at America's largest and best attended consumer electronics show 'CES 2011' held in Las Vegas, USA on Jan 6.

H67 ITX WIFI mainboard of ZOTAC is supporting i3 and i5 processor of 2nd generation Cord I 2000 series of Intel by adjusting LGA115 socket and is loaded SATA 3.0Gb/S port supporting 4 Raid mode, eSATA port and 4 USB 3.0 ports.
Also, because it has a PCI Express X16 port, on-boarded 802.11n wireless lan and even Ethernet port with Giga beat, loading all functionalities of mainboard general size to small board was possible.
ZOTAC is global enterprise which branches 'ZOTAC Korea(www.zotackor.com)' in Korea and is well received at market with trustful quality.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
